page.overview:
What is Seer?

A Misting that can burn atium is called a Seer. They are the most powerful Mistings of all, though without steel, pewter, or other Allomantic abilities, they are only useful as strategizing soldiers. Category:Mistborn Category:Cosmere Category:Magic Systems
